coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Uber Mission Bay 1

milestones.text: Uber Mission Bay 1 (1455 3rd St) completed (ArchDaily lists the project as 2022; no source read gives a month)
OpenAI subleases 1455 & 1515 3rd St from Uber (~486,600 sq ft combined), the largest SF office lease since 2018

changes.text: OpenAI was shown as open at 1455 3rd St on the strength of a 2023 SF Standard report of a signed lease; it now shows the tenant as announced with no opening date. Uber was shown as open since June 2020 based only on a DataSF business registration that predates the building's completion, at a building later subleased to OpenAI; that tenant listing was removed, and the related timeline entry now describes it as a registration. The completion milestone said June 2021 with only a website's home page as its source; ArchDaily gives 2022, so it now reads 2022 (the status notes say the same, and that the Assessor has no year built). A pile-driver milestone sourced only to a website's home page was removed. The joint venture (Alexandria 51%, Uber 49%, formed September 2014) now cites Alexandria's 3Q14 supplemental, which also calls the two buildings Class A. The OpenAI lease milestone cites the SF Standard and Real Deal articles.
changes.source: The San Francisco Standard, 2023-10-27 (https://sfstandard.com/2023/10/27/openai-uber-headquarters-mission-bay/); The Real Deal, 2023-10-29 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2023/10/29/openai-subleases-two-san-francisco-buildings-from-uber/); ArchDaily, Uber Headquarters / SHoP Architects (https://www.archdaily.com/1006339/uber-headquarters-shop-architects); Alexandria Real Estate Equities 3Q14 supplemental, SEC (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1035443/000103544314000075/a3q14-ex991.htm); DataSF Registered Business Locations (https://data.sfgov.org/Economy-and-Community/Registered-Business-Locations-San-Francisco/g8m3-pdis)

changes.text: SF Standard reported on 2023-10-27 that OpenAI is leasing two buildings at 1455 and 1515 Third St from Uber, described as the largest office lease in San Francisco since 2018. The article reports the lease, not an operating office.

DataSF Registered Business Locations lists Uber Technologies Inc at 1455 3rd St with a location start date of 2020-06-25. A registration is not an opening, and it predates the building's completion (ArchDaily lists the project as 2022), so it does not show an Uber office opening there.

record.notes: Uber Mission Bay 1, 1455 3rd St -- an 11-story Class A office tower developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51%) and Uber Technologies (49%), formed in September 2014 per Alexandria's 3Q14 supplemental, designed by SHoP Architects, part of Uber's four-building Mission Bay headquarters campus (ArchDaily lists the project as 2022; the Assessor gives no year built for this parcel). Subleased to OpenAI along with 1515 3rd St in an October 2023 deal (~486,600 sq ft combined), reported as the largest SF office lease since 2018.
